description.value: Ward's Wine Country Kitchen is a locally owned sit-down restaurant at The District Wine Village in Oliver, BC, in the heart of Okanagan wine country. Founded by Scott and Mindy Ward, who bring a combined 80 years of Canadian hospitality experience, the kitchen is led by Executive Chef Ian Stilborn, whose seasonal menu features shareable plates, flatbreads, burgers, poke bowls, and specialty cocktails. Online takeout ordering is available for cyclists wanting to bring a meal on the road.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website is active and current (references May 2026 hours and an upcoming June 2026 event), confirming an open restaurant at 100 Enterprise Way #101, Oliver, BC with phone 236-488-0114. Takeout is explicitly confirmed on the homepage ('On-line ordering is now live. Order Take Out'); at least one vegetarian option is confirmed on the spring menu ('the garden burger — veggie patty'). No cyclist-specific amenities (bike parking, water refill, Wi-Fi, charging) are mentioned anywhere on the site, so those remain null.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM uses 'Ward's Wine Country Kitchen' (with apostrophe); website consistently uses 'Wards Wine Country Kitchen' (no apostrophe).
OSM record contains no address or phone number; both sourced from website only.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Active, open restaurant in Oliver, BC with a current seasonal menu, confirmed contact details, and online takeout — a useful stop for touring cyclists in the Okanagan wine region.

Vegetarian / vegan / GF.detail: Spring menu includes 'the garden burger — veggie patty + aged cheddar + house aioli + arugula + pickles + potato bun'
